sql_templates.description: Extract recent route failures in position-sizing context.
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_runs AS (
    SELECT run_id, run_ts, analysis_date, universe_size, stocks_analyzed, stocks_filtered
    FROM report.enhanced_runs
    WHERE run_ts > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
recent_filtered_stocks AS (
    SELECT ef.run_id, ef.symbol, ef.recommendation
    FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks ef
    JOIN recent_runs rr ON ef.run_id = rr.run_id
)
SELECT rr.run_id, rr.analysis_date, rr.universe_size, 
       COUNT(efs.symbol) AS filtered_symbols_count
FROM recent_runs rr
LEFT JOIN recent_filtered_stocks efs ON rr.run_id = efs.run_id
GROUP BY rr.run_id, rr.analysis_date, rr.universe_size
LIMIT 100;

sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_flows AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    fii_net_5d,
    dii_net_5d,
    flow_signal
  FROM
    signals.fii_dii_flows
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
),
latest_regime AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    regime,
    confidence
  FROM
    signals.regime_history
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.regime_history)
),
latest_breadth AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    adv_signal,
    trin_signal
  FROM
    breadth.market_daily
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM breadth.market_daily)
),
latest_index AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    close,
    trend_signal
  FROM
    market.index_eod
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod)
    AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT
  lf.trade_date,
  lf.fii_net_5d,
  lf.dii_net_5d,
  lf.flow_signal,
  lr.regime,
  lr.confidence,
  lb.adv_signal,
  lb.trin_signal,
  li.close,
  li.trend_signal
FROM
  latest_flows lf
  JOIN latest_regime lr ON lf.trade_date = lr.trade_date
  JOIN latest_breadth lb ON lf.trade_date = lb.trade_date
  JOIN latest_index li ON lf.trade_date = li.trade_date;

synthesis_guidance: {'notes': "To assess the market context, evaluate the interplay between the FII and DII flows, the current market regime, breadth signals, and the index's technical state."}
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1856
